integrity.historical_risk: A 2026 general domination characterization for the same host supports a short derivation of the independence specialization; equivalent earlier results under other terminology remain possible.

scientific_limitations: Only two-token complete bipartite graphs with both side sizes at least two. The polynomial counts labelled maximal independent sets. Independent validation and exhaustive historical priority verification are not performed.
title: Maximal independent-set polynomial and sharp independent domination of two-token complete bipartite graphs
